name: Teshikaga (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Teshikaga town emblem in navy and white: a navy disc bearing a white stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Teshikaga, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 1961.

features.role: Teshikaga town emblem — a navy disc bearing a white stylised mountain
